articles.title: pnpm 11.28.6
articles.summary: This release stops pnpm publish from sending a CI identity token to a registry it was not issued for. It also fixes installs that dropped a dependency also declared as an optional peer, and accepts empty httpProxy and httpsProxy settings again. Patch Changes Security pnpm publish now uses an NPM_ID_TOKEN only if its aud claim matches the selected registry, such as npm:registry.npmjs.org . A token for another registry is skipped with a warning, and pnpm falls back to the configured credentials. The warning about renamed package files with invalid names no longer prints control characters...

articles.title: pnpm 12.14.0
articles.summary: This release adds the sideEffectsCache.exclude setting, stops pnpm install from waiting on the daily update check, and keeps pnpm from aborting with a core dump when the reader of its output exits. Minor Changes Added the sideEffectsCache.exclude setting for packages whose build depends on something pnpm cannot include in the cache key, such as the system libraries a native addon links against. pnpm builds the listed packages in every project and never restores or saves their builds through the side-effects cache, locally or on a remoteCache server.
